Opposite Party/s

 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Prabhat Ranjan Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Braj Kishore Pd., App.
 Mr. Satya Prakash Parashar, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
7 17-08-2023 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 307, 309, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Petitioner, who is husband of complainant, is said to have tortured upon the complainant physically and mentally and ousted her from the matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
They also tried to kill the complainant.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.54472 of 2022(7) dt.17-08-2023 drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.
He is still ready to keep her with full honour and dignity.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @
Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
5.

1 furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No. 1046 C of 2019, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6. Petitioner is ready to pay Rs.5,000.00 (Rupees Five Thousand) per month to the complainant in the second week of every month.

sentences.text: If the petitioner fails to pay the aforesaid amount on two consecutive months, complainant shall be at liberty to move before the learned Court below for cancelling the bail bond of the petitioner.

7. It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.54472 of 2022(7) dt.17-08-2023 be subject to any order being passed in matrimonial maintenance case or any other collateral proceedings.
8. Learned counsel for the complainant is directed to furnish the complainant's bank account details.

If he fails to furnish the same, the aforesaid amount will be deposited in the learned Court below which will be released in favour of the complainant after he furnishes the complainant's bank account details.

9. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
10. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this application stands disposed of.
